origin.title: Follow a source
origin.description: Link this skill to the repository it came from, and it gets updates. Its files stay as they are until you update.
origin.finding: Looking in the folder it came from, links in its SKILL.md and {{marketplace}}…
origin.pastePlaceholder: Or paste a link: owner/repo, a GitHub folder link, a clone URL
origin.mineHint: Stop looking for a source for this skill
origin.mineNotice: You marked this skill as your own, so {{app}} does not look for a source for it.
origin.unmarkedMine: “{{name}}” is no longer marked as yours
origin.nothingFound: No source found. Paste the repository link if you know it, or mark the skill as yours.
origin.linkedDiffers_one: It shows an update. Your changed file is kept until you update, and updating asks first.
origin.linkedDiffers_other: It shows an update. Your {{count}} changed files are kept until you update, and updating asks first.
origin.confirmDescription_one: Your copy differs from the latest version in {{count}} file. Nothing changes now: the skill shows an update, and updating asks before replacing your changed file.
origin.confirmDescription_other: Your copy differs from the latest version in {{count}} files. Nothing changes now: the skill shows an update, and updating asks before replacing your changed files.

evidence.skills_lock: The npx skills lock file on this computer says it was installed from here

batch.description: For each skill without a source, {{app}} looks in the folder it came from, links in its SKILL.md and {{marketplace}}, and compares what it finds with your copy. Tick the ones to link.

batch.otherMatches_other: {{count}} other matches on its Source tab
